# Fetch all liked songs across all pages to build a set of liked song IDs.

liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    page_index += 1
